idea: Themed weeks, week four, Money day: written from the source, then corrected by a numbers editor and a viewer editor before voicing.
description: At end-March 2025, regional rural banks held 33.4% of all bank deposits in Mizoram, the highest of 29 states and UTs with a figure; India's share was 2.9%. Regional rural banks are banks set up to serve rural areas. They were also 44.8% of Mizoram's bank offices (India: 13.4%).

Mizoram's share has been the highest in each of the seven years from end-March 2019 to 2025; at end-March 2018 Tripura's was higher, 27.0% against Mizoram's 25.4%. Scheduled commercial banks, regional rural banks among them. A deposit is counted where the bank office is. State totals as shares, not per person.
source: Reserve Bank of India, Handbook of Statistics on Indian States 2024-25 (December 2025), Tables 160, 155, 163 and 152: deposits of regional rural banks, deposits of all scheduled commercial banks (regional rural banks are among them), and bank offices, as at end-March 2018 to 2025. A deposit is counted where the bank office is. State totals as shares, not per person.

done: Numbers editor recomputed with python3 -I from Handbook Tables 160, 155, 163 and 152: Mizoram 5,828 / 17,462 = 33.38%; India 6,90,414 / 2,34,51,838 = 2.94%; 29 states and UTs with a figure; Tripura next at 23.89%; offices 108 / 241 = 44.81% against India 22,481 / 1,67,806 = 13.40%; 2018 Tripura 26.98 against Mizoram 25.37; Mizoram's lead in each year 2019 to 2025. Read the Handbook 2024-25 notes for the four tables.

Settled whether the all-bank tables include regional rural banks: RBI never says so in the Handbook notes, but RBI's press releases of 29 May 2026 say the annual data include them, and T160 / T155 for India gives 3.21% for 2022, which matches RBI's 3.2%.

Fixed before voicing: the title now says 'Regional Rural Banks' (bare 'Rural Banks' reads as any bank in a rural area); 'small banks serving rural areas' became 'banks set up to serve rural areas' (the source does not say small). Viewer editor removed a card that repeated 'led since 2019'.
Margins: the 2025 lead passes the guide's margins; the thinnest year is 2019 (1.20 points), which passes by a little, and the 2018 exception is shown on card 3.

Claude checked every figure quoted in this pack's description, Instagram text, X post and pinned comment against the built data.json (screen text, voice lines and the builder's own checks); none is new.
